summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice for Tom Allen, "the retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening and showing Smith and Kilrain's colors at the bar.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, December 3, 1887, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen ran a saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertising free concerts every evening and displaying Jem Smith's and Jake Kilrain's colors at the bar

notes: Same notice as article 744 (Missouri Republican, same day).
